The tool whose batteries no longer exist.
The Power Tool and Battery Zone in the Garage. Holds the powered tools, their packs, and their chargers so a tool is always ready to run and nothing is left charging unattended.

What done looks like:
1. One shelf per battery system with its charger mounted at the front edge
2. No pack sitting on it
3. Saw in its case or on a labelled hook with guards down
4. Sanding discs in the shallow drawer underneath

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success power tool and battery zone.
